title: translate.text
description: Translate a batch of plain content texts through the configured LLM provider (same facade, bounds and cache as POST text/). Returns {texts: [string]} of the same length and order; blank texts come back unchanged. source null lets the provider detect it. Refusals raise with a message starting with error.400.translate.{text_too_long,batch_too_large,batch_too_long,unsupported_language}; no provider configured or a failed provider raises error.503.translate.unavailable — never an untranslated copy.

texts.description: Plain texts to translate; the answer keeps their order.

source.description: Source language code; null lets the provider detect it.

format.description: Text format. Only plain text is supported.
